model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the overall performance of various Large Language Models (LLMs) in the EBS-AOS pattern, categorized into three tiers based on their performance. The horizontal axis represents the LLMs, listed in no specific order, while the vertical axis represents the overall performance percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at regular intervals of 20. The chart features nine bars, each representing a different LLM, with varying colors and heights. The shortest bar corresponds to a performance of 34.24, and the tallest bar corresponds to a performance of 77.12. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and height. The chart also includes a stratification of the LLMs into three tiers: Tier-1, with performances between 72 and 77; Tier-2, with performances between 64 and 68; and Tier-3, with performances between 34 and 46.
